notes: Shelf 'Scales, thermometers & timers' rebuilt from 6 old kinds to 3. Pocket scale (k38, an eBay SKU) folded into Kitchen scale as a type; the three thermometer kinds (Meat, Infrared, Other) merged into one Kitchen thermometer kind with instant-read, leave-in alarm, wireless, infrared, oven, candy/deep-fry, dial and pop-up as types. Thermapen (ThermoWorks) and MEATER built as archetypes with versions taken from retrieved maker pages (thermoworks.com product pages, meater.com) and the AmazingRibs Mk4 review (2015); launch years for Classic, ONE and MEATER models were not confirmed on retrieved pages so are left blank. Old ThermoWorks models (ThermoPop 2, ChefAlarm, Signals) kept in m; Gravitas kept under Kitchen scale. Tier models for scales limited to brands seen on retrieved pages (Escali Primo, OXO pull-out display scale, My Weigh KD-8000 from a Tom's Guide review, Salter as a range); Salter model names were not confirmed so only the range is listed. Coffee scales are left to the Coffee department as instructed. Kitchen timer kept as one kind with hourglass/mechanical/digital types and no models (no retrieved model pages). No craft traditions apply. Wiki tool was intermittently erroring, so Wikipedia pages were retrieved via web_fetch.
